inputs.text: [serious] He was a herbivore. He grazed on plants in a big herd. [confident] When a big hunter got close, [quickly] he may have let out a deep call through his crest, to warn his friends.
[curious] He called out through his crest?
[playful] Yes. His hollow crest worked like a big natural horn. [warmly] The whole herd could hear it from far away, and run to safety together.
